topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The ground shifted, a whisper of soil giving way to my paws. Something isn’t as it should be, a disturbance unseen but felt. I approach, curious, the air carrying no scent of threat, only the earth's rich, steady pulse. There, a thing not of this moment, not of this place, lays half-exposed. It’s cool, oddly shaped, bearing no resemblance to the usual stones or roots I know. My tongue flicks out, tasting its surface—metallic, foreign. What purpose does it serve? Who placed it here, and why? The forest watches, silent. I nuzzle it, considering, then step back. It’s not prey, not a foe. Perhaps it’s best left, a mystery to ponder as the leaves dance and the river sings.
